verdict_reason: The new species tests fail without the code they cover and use no mocks, but one title over-claims and an existing comment describes the scan stub.

todos.issue: 'Should name each species of a draft MDM no longer lists, with its code' seeds only one unlisted line, so the assertion proves one species is named and a listed one is left out; the ', ' join that 'each' claims is never exercised and could break unnoticed.
todos.fix: Must: the title states what the assertion proves, or the test proves every unlisted species is named. One way: seed two unlisted lines (e.g. 'Bos spp.' under 0102 and another unlisted pair) beside the listed one and assert speciesNoLongerOffered('Bos spp. (0102), <second> (<code>)').

todos.issue: The comment in 'Should refuse a notification whose stored document is still being scanned' ('Stub scanStatus maps filename -> status when the uploadId has not been seen by upload()...') describes another module, the scan stub, not the lines below it.
todos.fix: Must: the test needs no comment to explain why its fixture stays pending. One way: delete the comment and let the constant name carry it (PENDING_FILENAME already says it; e.g. rename to STAYS_PENDING_FILENAME if more is needed).
